HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP MARCH — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #13
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   C. Skip evidence when discussing Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya.
   D. Explain Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
